entities.summary: Seth Kwame Acheampong is a Ghanaian politician and was a member of the MPs elected in the Ghanaian parliamentary election, 2009 - 2020 representing the Mpraeso Constituency in the Eastern Region on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party. In 2020, he lost the bid to lead the New Patriotic Party going into the parliamentary elections to Davis Ansah Opoku. He is currently serving as the minister of the Eastern Region.
